title: Data movement in one screen
rememberThis: DataSync for bulk on-prem ↔ cloud migration; S3 CRR for ongoing bucket-level replication between regions.
S3 replication requires versioning enabled on source and destination; replicates only new objects after rule.
Batch (Glue/EMR) for periodic ETL; streaming (Kinesis) when latency matters more than simplicity.
Encrypt in transit (TLS) and at rest (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS); scope IAM to bucket prefix not entire account.
CloudTrail data events audit who read/wrote which S3 objects during migration.
bullets: DataSync agent needs outbound HTTPS to AWS; plan firewall rules before cutover weekend.
CRR does not replicate existing objects — run one-time DataSync or S3 Batch Replication.
Replication Time Control (RTC) adds SLA for 15-minute replication at extra cost.
Kinesis shard count sets throughput ceiling; scale shards before black Friday traffic.
VPC endpoints for S3 keep migration traffic off public internet from private subnets.
